title: 1371. Find the Longest Substring Containing Vowels in Even Counts

examples.explanation: The longest substring is "leetminicowor" which contains two each of the vowels: e, i and o and zero of the vowels: a and u.
The longest substring is "leetc" which contains two e's.
In this case, the given string "bcbcbc" is the longest because all vowels: a, e, i, o and u appear zero times.
